summary: Iteration 17 — Full regression for i18n (EN/AR/ES + RTL), analytics consent gating, referral registration banner, and localized 'Privacy choices' footer link. ALL CRITICAL CHECKS PASS. (1) Login admin@ariadni.id/Ariadni@2026 -> /dashboard OK. (2) Localization verified for Leads, CreateCard /templates, ScanCardDialog body, AnalyticsDialog: EN body, AR body with document dir=rtl and Arabic characters and 0px horizontal overflow, ES body — all bodies switch. Sample: Scan EN 'Scan a card ... Unlimited scans on your plan / Business card / Capture / Upload / Scan card', Scan AR 'مسح بطاقة ... مسح غير محدود في خطتك / بطاقة عمل / التقاط / رفع / مسح البطاقة', Scan ES 'Escanear una tarjeta ... Escaneos ilimitados en tu plan / Tarjeta de visita / Capturar / Subir / Escanear tarjeta'. Analytics AR shows 'التحليلات · Feras Askar / مشاهدات الملف / مسح QR / نقرات الإجراءات / الاستفسارات / النقرات حسب الإجراء'. CreateCard AR shows 'مدير البطاقات / أنشئ بطاقتك / حفظ كمسودة / نشر البطاقة / اختر مجالك / خصّص أسلوبك / معلوماتك'. (3) Analytics consent gate on /feras-askar public card via observed network: tp_consent analytics=false -> 0 POST /api/cards/feras-askar/track calls fired; analytics=true -> 4 POSTs fired (view + scan on ?src=qr); no tp_consent (default) -> 2 POSTs fired. Semantics correct: block only when EXPLICITLY rejected. (4) Referral banner on /register?ref=A9EB29F9 fetches /api/commercial/pricing and shows '🎁 Invited with code A9EB29F9 — you'll get 20% off your plan.' with data-testid=register-referral-banner; hides on /register with no ref param. (5) Localized 'Privacy choices' footer link data-testid=footer-privacy-choices renders EN='Privacy choices', navigates to /privacy-center; page renders with LanguageSwitcher and consent-toggle-analytics + consent-save. (6) Privacy Center saves choice into localStorage tp_consent (verified {analytics:true} and {analytics:false} both persist). (7) Public /feras-askar card renders QR + Exchange Contact CTA. (8) Language/currency independence: setting tp_market=EUR then changing ariadni_lang from en to ar preserves tp_market=EUR after reload. (9) Backend endpoints verified 200: /api/commercial/pricing (referral.enabled=true, referred_discount_month_pct=20), /api/cards/feras-askar, POST /api/cards/feras-askar/track, /api/referral/qr?code=A9EB29F9 image/png. No regressions found.

ConsentBanner + PrivacyCenter both call detectMarket() on every render — memoize at module scope (carried over from iter16).
platform_v1.py still >700 lines — split recommendation carried over.

createCard.* namespace is well factored; industry template preview cards (Alex Morgan / Michael Anderson / Jessica Taylor 'Real Estate Consultant', 'Call/Email/WhatsApp/Save/Exchange Contact/Tap your card') are hard-coded EN sample data inside the industry preview grid, NOT localized. Acceptable as demo/sample content, but if intended to be user-visible in AR/ES it should be moved to locales.
